description: Read one document by the id search returned. No API key. The result has id, title, text, url, and metadata. Template metadata includes trialUrl from the template sign-up link. An org API key or OAuth token with forms:read can read form:<id> for a live published form in that organization. The text lists field labels and types. url is the public form URL, and metadata includes the same share links as get_form. A draft, an archived form, a deleted form, an unknown id, and a form in another organization are not found. The result leaves out applicant data. Workers AI stays off.

id.description: Id from a search hit. Public ids start with doc: or template:. Organization form ids start with form:.

name: fetch

metadata.description: String pairs. kind is doc, template, or form.

title: Fetch a document
